Please solve this issue:

## Bug Description

POSIX requires pthread_join() on a detached or already-joined thread to return EINVAL. The base kernel returns ESRCH instead. This 17-file refactor introduces sched/task/task_join.c as a dedicated join-task abstraction and rewires pthread_join(), pthread_detach(), pthread_completejoin(), pthread_findjoininfo(), and pthread_release() so that joining a detached thread correctly returns EINVAL. Apps PR #2329 updates cancel_test in testing/ostest/cancel.c to assert EINVAL (not ESRCH). On the base kernel, cancel_test prints 'ERROR pthread_join failed but with wrong status=3' — the test fails to reach its PASS line.

## Failing Tests (must pass after your fix)

  - cancel_test: PASS pthread_join failed with status=EINVAL
  - ostest completes and exits with status 0

## Tests That Must Continue Passing

  - NuttX boots and NSH prompt appears

## Relevant Source File(s)

  - sched/pthread/pthread_join.c
  - sched/pthread/pthread_completejoin.c
  - sched/pthread/pthread_detach.c
  - sched/pthread/pthread_findjoininfo.c
  - sched/pthread/pthread_release.c
  - sched/task/task_join.c
  - sched/task/task.h

First, I'll introduce the new core abstraction for task joining. This involves creating `sched/task/task_join.c`, updating `include/nuttx/sched.h` and `sched/pthread/pthread.h` with the new data structures, adding function prototypes to `sched/task/task.h`, and wiring up the new file in the build system.
